@@ -26,8 +26,8 @@ jobs:
       - name: Install dependencies
         run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

-        run: bun run lint && bun run check

         run: bun run build

     "lint": "biome check . && node scripts/check-boundaries.js",

     "test:unit": "node scripts/test-lane.js ./tests/unit --coverage --timeout 20000",
